decision.release_claim: The versioned semantic contract implements every named entity class at declared catalogue/schema grain, with source-grounded fixtures. The federation does not claim complete case, court, provision or other source-family entity ingestion.

limitations: Deterministic projection cannot create source-native identifiers for entities that have not been acquired.
Cases and courts are source-family catalogue entries, not ingested entity corpora.
Provision URIs in official effects and on-demand CLML discovery do not constitute a complete frozen provision inventory.
Embedded expression, manifestation, organisation, publication, jurisdiction and temporal fields must not be described as complete standalone entity inventories.
scope: Evidence-backed assessment of the entity classes named by P04-01 at the federation's declared catalogue and snapshot grain.
